source_title: NCDOT Oversize/Overweight Permit Handbook + Superload Permits Pub SL-6 (Rev 10/18)

superload_thresholds.note: Superload when any of: gross over 132,000 lbs, width over 15', or axle/axle-group weights exceeding permit policy (e.g. steer axle over 20,000 lbs). Requires Form PF-20 with axle schematics submitted at least 10 working days ahead for internal + bridge-engineering review (bridge studies expire after 90 days). Height is not a superload trigger — a front pole car is required over 14'5" instead; length is not a superload trigger (null).

width.note: 1 escort over 12' up to 14' wide — front on two-lane/two-way, rear on multilane (NCDOT Handbook, Pub E-9)
over 14' to 16' wide: front + rear escort on two-lane; 1 escort on multilane
over 16' wide: 3 escorts total, one of which must be NC State Highway Patrol (SL-6)

height.note: front pole-car escort with height-pole indicator over 14'5" high; overheight applications over 14' reviewed by Central Permit Office

length.note: 1 rear escort over 110' overall length; also rear escort for rear overhang of 15' or more
front + rear escort at 150' or greater overall length

weight.note: front escort required over 149,999 lbs gross (NCDOT Handbook); over_ft value is a POUNDS threshold

single_trip.fee_formula: Single-trip state fee $12 per over-legal dimension (width/height/length/weight), $12-$48 total; valid 10 calendar days, one trip. Superload adds a $100 non-refundable application fee (waived if width under 17') + $12 per over-legal dimension + $3.00 per 1,000 lbs over 132,000 lbs gross.
single_trip.note: Permit weight is axle-based: steer 20,000 / single 25,000 / tandem 50,000 / tridem 60,000 / 4+ grouping 68,000 lbs plus bridge-structure allowance; over 132,000 lbs gross is superload.

annual.note: Annual permit $100 per vehicle (non-divisible general commodities); $200 per vehicle for mobile homes. House-mover license $100/yr. Annual overweight requires 51-ft min wheelbase, up to 90,000 lbs, not on posted roads/bridges.

movement_restrictions: General/self-propelled: Monday-Saturday sunrise to sunset; no Sunday travel unless stated on the permit. Continuous 24/7 travel allowed only if gross is 112,000 lbs or under AND no overdimension of width/length/height.
Loads over 12' wide: metro rush-hour ban within a 10-mile radius of Charlotte, Raleigh, Durham and Chapel Hill during 7-9 a.m. and 4-6 p.m.
16-ft mobile homes: Monday-Saturday 9:00 a.m.-2:30 p.m. only.

Holiday travel bans (loads over 112,000 lbs and/or over-dimension): from noon the weekday before to noon the weekday after New Year's, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas.
Superloads: sunrise to sunset only, Monday-Sunday; continuous 24/7 travel never authorized for a superload.
No movement when visibility under 500 ft or in snow/ice; mobile/modular units over 10' wide prohibited when wind gusts exceed 25 mph.
notes: Legal width 8'6", height 13'6", tractor + 53' semitrailer unrestricted on NC primary routes. NC governs gross by axle/Federal Bridge Formula (G.S. 20-118) rather than a flat legal gross; single axle 20,000 / tandem 38,000 lbs — the 80,000 lbs legal gross recorded here is the federal interstate maximum used for permit triggering.
All values sourced from official NCDOT Handbook + SL-6 (Rev 10/18) fetched 2026-07-16 (public .aspx landing page 404'd; connect.ncdot.gov PDFs are authoritative). State-level rules only.
